brier_improvement_definition: brier_improvement = baseline_brier - thermal_brier; POSITIVE values mean the thermal model has the lower/better Brier score. The deprecated `delta_brier` field (thermal_brier - baseline_brier) uses the OPPOSITE sign convention (negative = thermal better) and is kept only for backward compatibility with v1-schema reports.
